name: OPNsense Hardening
summary: The firewall's own security events: web interface logins, brute force and forged log lines, configuration changes and who made them (NAT, logging, accounts, API keys, cron, certificates), logging or detection switched off, firmware, power and crashes, VPN and IPsec authentication, CARP and gateway state, CrowdSec decisions, Suricata alerts graded by what they say, and a daily vulnerability and version check.
summary_zh: 防火牆本身的資安事件：網頁介面登入、暴力破解與偽造的記錄行，設定變更與變更者（NAT、記錄、帳號、API 金鑰、排程、憑證），記錄或偵測被關閉，韌體、電源與程式當掉，VPN 與 IPsec 認證，CARP 與閘道狀態，CrowdSec 決策，依告警內容分級的 Suricata，以及每日的弱點與版本檢查。
notes: OPNsense writes its audit trail (web interface logins, failed logins, configuration changes, firmware actions) under the syslog name "audit". Wazuh decodes that name as Solaris BSM and drops it at rule 6100, level 0, so none of it ever alerted: measured on two firewalls, 549 audit lines in 30 days and no alert. This pack's decoders are children of that decoder, built from the format strings in the OPNsense source, and every rule was tested against real lines from those two firewalls where they exist.

Web interface: a successful login is recorded, not alerted (level 2), with no site list needed. It alerts when the account is the built-in superuser root (level 3), the first time an account logs in from an address on a firewall (level 3), from an address outside the private ranges (level 5, root level 8), and right after six failed logins from the same address (level 12). A failed login is level 5, six from one address in two minutes level 10. A user name with LDAP filter characters (* ( ) | &) is level 8 on a failure and level 12 on a success: CVE-2026-34578 (fixed in 26.1.6) let such names pass an LDAP server's check; failures stay at 8 because people also type a password into the user name field. Forged audit lines (GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q, fixed in 26.7.4: a line break in the posted user name writes extra lines) are level 10, recognised by the leftover every forgery leaves, and the alert carries the sender's real address. Logouts and expired sessions are recorded. Requests for pages without a session (stale browser tabs, scanners; measured 37 a month per firewall from an nmap probe) are recorded, and twenty in a minute from one address are level 6.

Configuration changes: every save names the account (with its address), the page and the backup file that holds the new version. A change through the web interface or the API is level 5, and more by what changed: a new account, imported accounts or a new API key (it logs in without the second factor) level 8; logging and detection settings (remote syslog, intrusion detection, the Wazuh agent and CrowdSec plugins) level 8; accounts, privileges and authentication servers, administrative access, NAT and the page that holds "Disable Firewall", certificate authorities and removed revocation lists, a restored or reverted configuration level 7; cron jobs level 6; changes through XMLRPC level 5 (the HA synchronisation path, and the path of CVE-2026-44193). Changes saved by local processes (migrations, plugin scripts; a few a week) are level 3, from the console menu level 5, and a root password reset from the console level 7. Measured: 9 changes in 30 days on two firewalls, none of them in the raised classes.

Firmware and power: a firmware update, upgrade or package install from the web interface is level 5 and names the person; reboot and power off level 5. Through configd: a scheduled automatic update and a reboot or halt are level 5, flushing the configuration history level 5, a factory reset level 10. Package upgrades are recorded below the alert level (136 lines in one measured update); a package installed, removed or downgraded is level 3.

Logins through OPNsense's own authentication for services other than the web interface (SSH with a password, the console, IPsec users) carry no address. They are recorded (level 2); root (level 3) and the first login of an account on a firewall (level 3) alert, a failure is level 5, eight failures for one account in two minutes level 10, and a login right after them level 12. Measured: a configuration backup account logging in every hour made 191 level 3 alerts a month per firewall; now it makes one, the first time. Listing such accounts in etc/lists/jt-opnsense-service-accounts is optional tuning that silences even that one; their failures still alert.

OpenVPN: the built-in rules 81803 and 81804 call every TLS timeout a certificate failure or a possibly revoked user. Measured: 196 such alerts in a week from one phone on a bad network and no real failure. On OPNsense's OpenVPN instances a timed-out handshake is now recorded below the alert level, and thirty from one address in half an hour are level 5. A wrong user name or password is level 5 with the client address, six from one address in five minutes level 10; refusals by OPNsense's password check are level 5, a successful authentication is recorded (level 2; the built-in 81801 still shows the connection at level 3), a rejected certificate level 5 and a revoked one level 7. Other OpenVPN servers keep the built-in behaviour.

IPsec (strongSwan): a tunnel up is level 3, closed is recorded, an authentication failure (pre-shared key, certificate, XAuth, RADIUS, EAP) level 5, eight on one connection in five minutes level 10, a remote-access user login is recorded and its first login on a firewall level 3, a peer that stopped answering level 5. IKE requests from addresses that are not configured peers are recorded, and ten from one address in ten minutes are level 6. Built from the strongSwan source; the measured firewalls run no IPsec.

Gateways and high availability: dpinger exits on every gateway reconfiguration and the built-in rule 1004 read that as syslogd stopping (25 false level 5 alerts in three months on one firewall); it is now level 0. A gateway going down is level 5, other gateway alarms level 3. A CARP address becoming MASTER is level 7, BACKUP or INIT level 5, a demotion change level 4. A process that dies on a signal that dumps core (segmentation fault, abort; the FreeBSD kernel logs it) is level 6: on a firewall that is a bug or a memory corruption exploit against a daemon that parses network input, such as dhclient or the web interface. Measured: none in 30 days.

CrowdSec decisions are level 5 (the address is already blocked by CrowdSec), simulated ones level 3, a fatal CrowdSec error level 7. Rootcheck's "Files hidden inside directory" for /boot/efi, which is a FAT partition without link counts, is dropped (measured: 56 level 7 alerts a week on one firewall). The plugin's own active response is visible: an address added to its block list is level 3.

Through configd, the backend every action goes through: stopping logging, intrusion detection, the Wazuh agent or CrowdSec, deleting CrowdSec decisions or resetting the local log files is level 7; releasing an address from a table that holds blocked attackers (login protection, connection limits, the plugin's active response, CrowdSec) or emptying one is level 8. Those tools expire their entries without configd, so the line means a person or a script did it. A restart is not a stop and stays silent.

Suricata (the plugin's Intrusion detection events option): the built-in rule 86601 gives every IDS alert level 3. The pack grades them by what the alert itself says, with no list: compromise classes (trojan, command and control, C2 domains, credential theft, a successful privilege gain, exploit kits, coin mining) are level 10 whether blocked or not; an attack class sent from an inside address is level 7; priority 3 and 4 alerts and signatures that Proofpoint ET marks Informational are recorded at level 2; the rest keeps level 3. Measured on one internet-facing firewall over 41 days: 1,052 alerts at level 3 before, 186 after, the other 866 recorded below the alert level; none in the compromise or inside classes. The grading applies to every Suricata eve.json source on the manager, and the built-in malicious address and domain rules (99915-99918, level 9) still take precedence over the level 2 rule.

The opnsense agent group, when assigned, also checks the integrity of configd's actions (a new file there is a new root command), the boot hooks in rc.syshook.d and root's SSH keys, comparing content, owner and mode but not time stamps, so a firmware update alerts only for files whose content changed. With the plugin's Logcollector remote commands option on, it runs pkg audit and opnsense-version once a day: vulnerable packages are level 5, a community release older than 26.1.8 (CVE-2026-44193, CVE-2026-44194 and CVE-2026-45158, all code execution) level 7. Without that option the agent skips the two commands.

Firewall log (filterlog) is not changed. A single block is built-in rule 87701, level 5 with no_log, so it is counted but never stored, and only 87702 (18 blocks from one source in 45 seconds, level 10) alerts. That is deliberate: an internet-facing firewall blocks hundreds of thousands of packets a day (measured: 930,000 filterlog lines a day on one firewall) and a single block says nothing. Tick filter (filterlog) in the plugin only if 87702 is wanted, and expect that load on the agent and the manager.

What does not reach Wazuh through the plugin: it selects syslog programs, not facilities, so sshd (auth facility), API key failures (program api) and OPNsense's login protection (lockout_handler) cannot be selected. Key-based SSH logins leave no trace at all. The pack has rules for the API and login protection lines; they fire only if the firewall also sends syslog to the manager.

Prerequisites: OPNsense with the os-wazuh-agent plugin (1.3 tested), which writes the selected programs to /var/ossec/logs/opnsense_syslog.log in BSD syslog format. OPNsense's own log files under /var/log use RFC 5424, which Wazuh does not decode, so the plugin's file is the only usable source. Keep OPNsense at 26.1.8 or later (four advisories with code execution or an authentication bypass were fixed in 26.1.6 to 26.1.8), and at 26.7.4 or later before relying on the web interface brute-force response.

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 131501, 131537, 131533, 131536, 131534, 131535, 131507, 131528, 131529, 131585, 131589; jt_auth_failure on 131502, 131547, 131510, 131563, 131564; jt_auth_lockout on 131555. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. One copy per login: the web interface is tagged on the line with the address (131501, 131502 and their children), not on the authenticator line (131506, 131509); OpenVPN failures on the daemon line with the address (131563, 131564), not on the password script line (131566). OpenVPN successes (131567) decode the account as srcuser and are not tagged; certificate errors and IPsec failures name no account. 131503 and 131556 now count failures through pack-only groups (jt_opnsense_gui_failure on 131502, jt_opnsense_svc_failure on 131510) instead of if_matched_sid: same rules, same thresholds, but the failures also reach the cross-pack group lists, which skip any rule named by an if_matched_sid.

1.2.2: the daily pkg audit alert (131578) names the vulnerable packages and counts their CVEs. The agent group's command now pipes pkg-static audit -F through awk (logcollector runs commands with popen(), that is through /bin/sh), which folds the report into one line: "<summary> Vulnerable: openvpn-2.7.7; openssl35-3.5.9. CVEs: 4.". Before, only the summary reached a rule and every package line was a separate level 0 event, so the alert said how many but not which. Still one alert per firewall per day. The decoder accepts the old summary-only line too, so an agent that has not received the new group file keeps working. Packages are separated by "; " because FreeBSD versions can carry an epoch after a comma.
notes_zh: OPNsense 把稽核軌跡（網頁介面登入、登入失敗、設定變更、韌體操作）寫在 syslog 名稱「audit」底下。Wazuh 把這個名稱當成 Solaris BSM 解碼，並在規則 6100（level 0）丟掉，所以從來沒有告警過：實測兩台防火牆 30 天有 549 行稽核記錄、零筆告警。本套件的解碼器是那個解碼器的子解碼器，依 OPNsense 原始碼的格式字串撰寫；有真實記錄的情境，都用這兩台防火牆的真實記錄測過。

網頁介面：登入成功只記錄、不告警（level 2），不需要任何站台清單。以下情況才告警：帳號是內建超級使用者 root（level 3）、某帳號第一次從某位址登入某台防火牆（level 3）、來自私有網段以外的位址（level 5，root 為 level 8）、同一位址剛失敗六次後登入成功（level 12）。登入失敗為 level 5，同一位址兩分鐘內六次 level 10。使用者名稱含 LDAP 篩選字元（* ( ) | &）時，失敗為 level 8、成功為 level 12：CVE-2026-34578（26.1.6 修正）讓這種名稱能通過 LDAP 伺服器的檢查；失敗只到 8，因為也有人會把密碼打進使用者名稱欄位。偽造的稽核記錄行（GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q，26.7.4 修正：送出的使用者名稱含換行時會多寫出幾行）為 level 10，依每次偽造必然留下的殘段辨識，告警帶有送出者的真實位址。登出與工作階段逾時會記錄。沒有工作階段就要求頁面（過期的瀏覽器分頁、掃描器；實測每台每月 37 筆來自 nmap 探測）會記錄，同一位址一分鐘內 20 次為 level 6。

設定變更：每次儲存都會記下帳號（含來源位址）、頁面，以及保存新版本的備份檔。透過網頁介面或 API 的變更為 level 5，再依變更內容提高：新增帳號、匯入帳號或新增 API 金鑰（它登入時不需要第二因素）level 8；記錄與偵測設定（遠端 syslog、入侵偵測、Wazuh agent 與 CrowdSec 外掛程式）level 8；帳號、權限與認證伺服器、管理存取、NAT 與含有「Disable Firewall」的頁面、憑證授權單位與被刪除的撤銷清單、還原或回復設定 level 7；排程工作 level 6；透過 XMLRPC 的變更 level 5（HA 同步的路徑，也是 CVE-2026-44193 的路徑）。本機程序（移轉、外掛程式腳本；每週數筆）儲存的變更為 level 3，從主控台選單變更為 level 5，從主控台重設 root 密碼為 level 7。實測兩台防火牆 30 天 9 筆變更，沒有一筆屬於提高等級的類別。
韌體與電源：從網頁介面更新、升級韌體或安裝套件為 level 5，並記下操作者；重新開機與關機 level 5。經由 configd：排程自動更新、重新開機或停機為 level 5，清除設定歷程 level 5，回復原廠設定 level 10。套件升級記錄在告警等級之下（實測一次更新 136 行）；新增、移除或降版套件為 level 3。

網頁介面以外、透過 OPNsense 本身認證的登入（以密碼登入 SSH、主控台、IPsec 使用者）沒有來源位址。它們只記錄（level 2）；root（level 3）與某帳號第一次登入某台防火牆（level 3）會告警，失敗為 level 5，同一帳號兩分鐘內失敗八次 level 10，緊接著登入成功 level 12。實測一個每小時登入的設定備份帳號每台每月產生 191 筆 level 3；現在只有第一次的一筆。把這類帳號列入 etc/lists/jt-opnsense-service-accounts 是選用的調校，連那一筆也會靜音；失敗仍會告警。

OpenVPN：內建規則 81803 與 81804 把每一次 TLS 逾時都當成憑證失敗或「可能是已撤銷的使用者」。實測一支網路不穩的手機一週產生 196 筆，沒有一筆是真正的認證失敗。在 OPNsense 的 OpenVPN 執行個體上，逾時的交握現在記錄在告警等級之下，同一位址半小時內 30 次為 level 5。帳號或密碼錯誤為 level 5 並附來源位址，同一位址五分鐘內六次 level 10；OPNsense 密碼檢查拒絕為 level 5，認證成功只記錄（level 2；內建 81801 仍以 level 3 顯示連線），憑證被拒 level 5，已撤銷的憑證 level 7。其他 OpenVPN 伺服器維持內建行為。

IPsec（strongSwan）：通道建立為 level 3，關閉會記錄，認證失敗（預共享金鑰、憑證、XAuth、RADIUS、EAP）level 5，同一連線五分鐘內八次 level 10，遠端存取使用者登入只記錄，第一次登入某台防火牆為 level 3，對端不再回應 level 5。來自非設定對端的 IKE 請求會記錄，同一位址十分鐘內十次為 level 6。依 strongSwan 原始碼撰寫；實測的防火牆沒有使用 IPsec。

閘道與高可用：dpinger 每次重新設定閘道都會結束，內建規則 1004 把它當成 syslogd 停止（實測一台三個月 25 筆 level 5 誤報），現在為 level 0。閘道斷線為 level 5，其他閘道警示 level 3。CARP 位址成為 MASTER 為 level 7，變成 BACKUP 或 INIT 為 level 5，降級值變更為 level 4。程式因會產生 core 的訊號結束（區段錯誤、abort；FreeBSD 核心會記錄）為 level 6：在防火牆上那是程式錯誤，或是針對解析網路輸入的服務（例如 dhclient 或網頁介面）的記憶體破壞攻擊。實測 30 天沒有發生。

CrowdSec 的決策為 level 5（該位址 CrowdSec 已經封鎖），模擬決策 level 3，CrowdSec 嚴重錯誤 level 7。Rootcheck 對 /boot/efi 回報的「Files hidden inside directory」會被丟掉，那是沒有連結數的 FAT 分割區（實測一台每週 56 筆 level 7）。外掛程式本身的主動回應也看得到：位址被加入封鎖清單為 level 3。

經由 configd（所有操作都經過的後端）：停止記錄、入侵偵測、Wazuh agent 或 CrowdSec，刪除 CrowdSec 決策或清空本機記錄檔為 level 7；把位址從存放被封鎖攻擊者的表格（登入保護、連線數限制、外掛程式的主動回應、CrowdSec）移除，或清空這類表格為 level 8。這些工具到期移除時不經過 configd，所以出現這一行代表是人或腳本做的。重新啟動不是停止，不會告警。

Suricata（外掛程式的 Intrusion detection events 選項）：內建規則 86601 把每一筆 IDS 告警都設為 level 3。本套件依告警本身的內容分級，不需要清單：入侵後的類別（木馬、命令與控制、C2 網域、憑證竊取、取得權限成功、漏洞利用套件、挖礦）不論是否已封鎖都是 level 10；從內部位址送出的攻擊類別為 level 7；優先等級 3 與 4 的告警，以及 Proofpoint ET 標為 Informational 的特徵，記錄在 level 2；其餘維持 level 3。實測一台面向網際網路的防火牆 41 天：原本 1,052 筆 level 3，之後 186 筆，其餘 866 筆記錄在告警等級之下；入侵後與內部來源的類別都沒有發生。分級套用到 manager 上所有 Suricata eve.json 來源，內建的惡意位址與網域規則（99915-99918，level 9）仍優先於 level 2 的規則。

指派 opnsense agent 群組後，也會檢查 configd 動作（那裡多一個檔案就是多一個 root 指令）、rc.syshook.d 開機掛勾與 root 的 SSH 金鑰的檔案完整性，比對內容、擁有者與權限，不比對時間戳記，所以韌體更新只會對內容真的改變的檔案告警。開啟外掛程式的 Logcollector remote commands 選項後，每天執行一次 pkg audit 與 opnsense-version：有弱點的套件為 level 5，早於 26.1.8 的社群版本（CVE-2026-44193、CVE-2026-44194、CVE-2026-45158，都是遠端執行程式碼）為 level 7。沒有開啟該選項時，agent 會略過這兩個指令。

防火牆記錄（filterlog）不做更動。單一封鎖是內建規則 87701，level 5 且 no_log，只計數、從不儲存，只有 87702（同一來源 45 秒內 18 次封鎖，level 10）會告警。這是刻意的：面向網際網路的防火牆每天封鎖數十萬個封包（實測一台每天 930,000 行 filterlog），單一封鎖沒有資訊。只有需要 87702 時才在外掛程式勾選 filter（filterlog），並預期 agent 與 manager 的負載。
透過外掛程式送不到 Wazuh 的：外掛程式選的是 syslog 程式而不是 facility，所以 sshd（auth facility）、API 金鑰失敗（程式 api）與 OPNsense 的登入保護（lockout_handler）都無法勾選。以金鑰登入 SSH 完全不留痕跡。本套件仍有 API 與登入保護的規則，只有在防火牆另外把 syslog 送到 manager 時才會觸發。

前提：OPNsense 安裝 os-wazuh-agent 外掛程式（測試版本 1.3），它會把勾選的程式以 BSD syslog 格式寫進 /var/ossec/logs/opnsense_syslog.log。OPNsense 自己在 /var/log 下的記錄檔是 RFC 5424 格式，Wazuh 無法解碼，所以外掛程式的檔案是唯一可用的來源。請讓 OPNsense 保持在 26.1.8 以上（26.1.6 到 26.1.8 修正了四個遠端執行程式碼或繞過認證的弱點），要依賴網頁介面暴力破解的主動回應之前，請先升到 26.7.4 以上。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：131501, 131537, 131533, 131536, 131534, 131535, 131507, 131528, 131529, 131585, 131589；jt_auth_failure：131502, 131547, 131510, 131563, 131564；jt_auth_lockout：131555。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。每次登入只標一份：網頁介面標在有位址的那行（131501、131502 與其子規則），不標驗證器那行（131506、131509）；OpenVPN 失敗標在有位址的服務程式那行（131563、131564），不標密碼腳本那行（131566）。OpenVPN 成功（131567）的帳號解在 srcuser，不加標記；憑證錯誤與 IPsec 失敗沒有帳號。131503 與 131556 改以套件專屬群組計算失敗（131502 上的 jt_opnsense_gui_failure、131510 上的 jt_opnsense_svc_failure），不再用 if_matched_sid：同樣的規則與門檻，但失敗事件也能進入跨套件群組清單（被 if_matched_sid 指名的規則會被群組清單略過）。

1.2.2：每天的 pkg audit 告警（131578）會列出有弱點的套件名稱與 CVE 數量。agent 群組的指令改為把 pkg-static audit -F 的輸出交給 awk（logcollector 以 popen() 執行指令，也就是經過 /bin/sh），整理成一行：「<摘要> Vulnerable: openvpn-2.7.7; openssl35-3.5.9. CVEs: 4.」。原本只有摘要那一行會對到規則，每個套件那一行都是個別的 level 0 事件，所以告警只說有幾個、沒說是哪些。仍然是每台防火牆每天一則。解碼器也接受舊的只有摘要的格式，還沒收到新群組設定的 agent 照常運作。套件之間以「; 」分隔，因為 FreeBSD 的版本號可能帶有逗號後的 epoch。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: opnsense
agent_group.description: OPNsense firewalls with the os-wazuh-agent plugin: adds the CrowdSec log, file integrity of configd actions, boot hooks and root's SSH keys, and a daily pkg audit and version check (needs the plugin's Logcollector remote commands)

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Define the opnsense-fw command on every manager node (for the active responses)
setup.title_zh: 在每個 manager 節點定義 opnsense-fw 指令（主動回應需要）
setup.body: The active responses of this pack use the os-wazuh-agent plugin's own script, which the plugin installs on the firewall as /var/ossec/active-response/bin/opnsense-fw (it adds the address to the alias __wazuh_agent_drop and removes it again when the timeout expires, so timeout_allowed must be yes). Wazuh does not define that command by default: paste the block into ossec.conf on every manager node, inside <ossec_config>, and restart the manager or reload its configuration. The response only works on agents that have the script, that is OPNsense firewalls with the plugin and its Active response setting enabled (the default); on any other agent the command fails and nothing is blocked. Nothing is blocked until a response is switched on in this pack.
setup.body_zh: 本套件的主動回應使用 os-wazuh-agent 外掛程式自己的腳本，外掛程式把它安裝在防火牆的 /var/ossec/active-response/bin/opnsense-fw（它把位址加入 __wazuh_agent_drop 別名，逾時後再移除，所以 timeout_allowed 必須是 yes）。Wazuh 預設沒有定義這個指令：請把下列區塊貼進每個 manager 節點 ossec.conf 的 <ossec_config> 內，然後重新啟動 manager 或重新載入設定。這個回應只在有該腳本的 agent 上有效，也就是安裝了外掛程式、且其 Active response 設定已啟用（預設）的 OPNsense 防火牆；在其他 agent 上指令會失敗，什麼都不會被封鎖。在本套件中開啟回應之前，不會封鎖任何東西。
setup.verify: Before enabling a response, check that every node has the block: grep -A3 '<name>opnsense-fw</name>' /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf
setup.verify_zh: 開啟回應之前，確認每個節點都有這個區塊：grep -A3 '<name>opnsense-fw</name>' /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf

setup.title: Select the applications the plugin forwards (OPNsense web interface)
setup.title_zh: 選擇外掛程式要轉送的應用程式（OPNsense 網頁介面）
setup.body: On each firewall: Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings, field Applications. Tick audit (audit), configd (configd.py), kernel (kernel), pkg (pkg) and pkg (pkg-static), gateways (dpinger), openvpn (openvpn) if OpenVPN is used, ipsec (charon) if IPsec is used. filter (filterlog) only if the multiple-blocks alert 87702 is wanted: it is by far the largest source (measured 930,000 lines a day on one firewall). Then Apply. The plugin rewrites its syslog-ng filter and restarts the agent: the agent reconnects within seconds and traffic is not affected. Expected extra volume, measured: audit about 30 lines a day, configd from 400 to 50,000 lines a day (nearly all level 0), OpenVPN about 4,400 a day (a status poll every minute, level 0).
setup.body_zh: 每台防火牆：Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings 的 Applications 欄位。勾選 audit (audit)、configd (configd.py)、kernel (kernel)、pkg (pkg) 與 pkg (pkg-static)、gateways (dpinger)，有用 OpenVPN 時勾 openvpn (openvpn)，有用 IPsec 時勾 ipsec (charon)。只有需要多次封鎖告警 87702 時才勾 filter (filterlog)：它是最大的來源（實測一台每天 930,000 行）。然後按 Apply。外掛程式會改寫 syslog-ng 篩選並重新啟動 agent：agent 幾秒內重新連線，不影響流量。實測增加的量：audit 每天約 30 行，configd 每天 400 到 50,000 行（幾乎都是 level 0），OpenVPN 每天約 4,400 行（每分鐘一次狀態查詢，level 0）。
setup.verify: Log in to the web interface as root. Expect rule 131533 (level 3) for the firewall's agent on the manager; another account's first login from an address shows as 131536 (level 3).
setup.verify_zh: 以 root 登入網頁介面，manager 端該防火牆的 agent 應出現規則 131533（level 3）；其他帳號第一次從某位址登入會出現 131536（level 3）。

setup.title: Assign the firewalls to the opnsense group (CrowdSec, file integrity, daily checks)
setup.title_zh: 把防火牆加入 opnsense 群組（CrowdSec、檔案完整性、每日檢查）
setup.body: The group adds three things, each working only with an option of the plugin on: CrowdSec's own log file, keeping decisions, the overflows behind them and fatal errors (firewalls running os-crowdsec); file integrity of /usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d, /usr/local/etc/rc.syshook.d and /root/.ssh (the plugin's File integrity monitoring option; scanned every 12 hours, FreeBSD has no real-time mode); and a daily pkg audit and opnsense-version (the Logcollector remote commands option, see the step below). Nothing else in the pack depends on the group. File integrity compares content, owner and mode, not time stamps: after a firmware update expect built-in rule 550 (level 7) only for the actions and hooks whose content changed, usually a handful.
setup.body_zh: 群組會加上三樣東西，各自要外掛程式的某個選項開啟才有作用：CrowdSec 自己的記錄檔，只保留決策、觸發決策的事件與嚴重錯誤（執行 os-crowdsec 的防火牆）；/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d、/usr/local/etc/rc.syshook.d 與 /root/.ssh 的檔案完整性（外掛程式的 File integrity monitoring 選項；每 12 小時掃描一次，FreeBSD 沒有即時模式）；以及每日的 pkg audit 與 opnsense-version（Logcollector remote commands 選項，見下方步驟）。套件其他部分不依賴這個群組。檔案完整性比對內容、擁有者與權限，不比對時間戳記：韌體更新之後，只有內容真的改變的動作與掛勾會出現內建規則 550（level 7），通常只有幾個。
setup.verify: After CrowdSec's next decision, expect rule 131591 (level 5). On the firewall, /var/ossec/etc/shared/agent.conf now contains the text jt-opnsense-pkg-audit.
setup.verify_zh: CrowdSec 下一次做出決策後，應出現規則 131591（level 5）。防火牆上的 /var/ossec/etc/shared/agent.conf 應含有 jt-opnsense-pkg-audit 字樣。

setup.title: Optional: let the agent run the daily vulnerability and version check
setup.title_zh: 選用：讓 agent 每天執行弱點與版本檢查
setup.body: On each firewall in the opnsense group: Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings, tick Logcollector remote commands, then Apply (the plugin restarts the agent; it reconnects within seconds). The agent then runs two commands from the group configuration once a day: pkg-static audit -F, which downloads FreeBSD's vulnerability list (vuxml.freebsd.org) and checks the installed packages, the same check as System > Firmware > Status > Audit; and opnsense-version. Rule 131578 (level 5) reports vulnerable packages, 131579 (level 7) a community release older than 26.1.8. Risk: with this option on, anyone who can change the opnsense group's configuration on the manager can run any command as root on the firewall, so keep write access to the manager to the people who already administer the firewalls. The plugin's other checkbox, Wazuh remote commands (Active response tab), is not needed and has no effect in os-wazuh-agent 1.3: its template writes a misspelled option. Without the option the agent logs "Remote commands are not accepted from the manager" once at start and skips the two commands; the rest of the group still applies.
setup.body_zh: opnsense 群組裡的每台防火牆：Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings，勾選 Logcollector remote commands 後按 Apply（外掛程式會重新啟動 agent，幾秒內重新連線）。之後 agent 每天執行群組設定裡的兩個指令一次：pkg-static audit -F，它會下載 FreeBSD 的弱點清單（vuxml.freebsd.org）並檢查已安裝的套件，與 System > Firmware > Status > Audit 的檢查相同；以及 opnsense-version。規則 131578（level 5）回報有弱點的套件，131579（level 7）回報早於 26.1.8 的社群版本。風險：開啟這個選項後，任何能修改 manager 上 opnsense 群組設定的人，都能在防火牆上以 root 執行任意指令，所以 manager 的寫入權限只應給本來就管理防火牆的人。外掛程式的另一個勾選框 Wazuh remote commands（Active response 分頁）不需要，在 os-wazuh-agent 1.3 上也沒有作用：它的範本寫出拼錯的選項名稱。沒有開啟這個選項時，agent 啟動時會記錄一次「Remote commands are not accepted from the manager」並略過這兩個指令，群組其他設定照常生效。
setup.verify: On the firewall: grep jt-opnsense /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log shows no "not accepted" line after the restart. On the manager, a firewall older than 26.1.8 shows rule 131579 within a minute of the agent starting.
setup.verify_zh: 在防火牆上：grep jt-opnsense /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log 在重新啟動之後不應有「not accepted」的行。在 manager 上，早於 26.1.8 的防火牆會在 agent 啟動一分鐘內出現規則 131579。

setup.title: Optional: send intrusion detection alerts (Suricata) to Wazuh
setup.title_zh: 選用：把入侵偵測告警（Suricata）送到 Wazuh
setup.body: On firewalls running intrusion detection: Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings, tick Intrusion detection events, then Apply. The agent reads /var/log/suricata/eve.json. The pack grades the alerts with no list (rules 131596, 131500, 131599; see the notes) and the grading applies to every Suricata eve.json source on the manager, not only OPNsense. If the manager already has rules of its own under the built-in 86601, they become siblings of these: remove or retire them, or the result depends on rule levels. Measured volume on one internet-facing firewall: about 26 alerts a day before grading, about 5 after.
setup.body_zh: 有執行入侵偵測的防火牆：Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings，勾選 Intrusion detection events 後按 Apply。agent 會讀取 /var/log/suricata/eve.json。本套件不用清單就能把告警分級（規則 131596、131500、131599，見說明），分級套用到 manager 上所有 Suricata eve.json 來源，不只 OPNsense。若 manager 上已有自己掛在內建 86601 底下的規則，它們會和這些規則成為同層規則：請移除或停用，否則結果取決於規則等級。實測一台面向網際網路的防火牆：分級前每天約 26 筆告警，分級後約 5 筆。
setup.verify: The next IDS alert of a low-priority signature shows as rule 131596 in the archives (level 2, not in alerts); a compromise-class alert as 131599.
setup.verify_zh: 下一筆低優先等級特徵的 IDS 告警，在 archives 中為規則 131596（level 2，不會出現在 alerts）；入侵後類別的告警則為 131599。

setup.title: Keep the web interface brute-force response off before OPNsense 26.7.4
setup.title_zh: OPNsense 26.7.4 之前，不要開啟網頁介面暴力破解的主動回應
setup.body: Up to 26.7.3 (and 26.4.2 of the Business Edition) a line break in the user name posted to the login page writes extra audit lines (GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q). One piece of each forged record can be a clean "failed login from <any address>" line, and six of them make block-gui-bruteforce block an address the attacker chose: an administrator's workstation, the manager, a partner. Rule 131539 (level 10) reports the leftover every forgery leaves, with the real sender, but it cannot unmake the clean piece. Leave that response off on such firewalls. The fix in 26.7.4 turns line breaks into spaces in OPNsense's own log files; whether the plugin's copy (/var/ossec/logs/opnsense_syslog.log) gets the same treatment was not verified, so test it on your version before enabling the response there too. Also keep OPNsense at 26.1.8 or later: CVE-2026-34578 (26.1.6), CVE-2026-44193 (26.1.7), CVE-2026-44194 and CVE-2026-45158 (26.1.8).
setup.body_zh: 26.7.3 以前（以及 Business Edition 的 26.4.2），在登入頁送出的使用者名稱裡放換行，就能多寫出稽核記錄行（GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q）。每一筆偽造記錄中，可以有一段是乾淨的「某位址登入失敗」行，位址任選；六段就會讓 block-gui-bruteforce 封鎖攻擊者指定的位址：管理者的工作站、manager 本身、合作夥伴。規則 131539（level 10）會回報每次偽造必然留下的殘段並附上真正的送出者，但無法讓那段乾淨的行消失。這類防火牆請不要開啟該回應。26.7.4 的修正會把 OPNsense 自己記錄檔裡的換行換成空白；外掛程式的那份副本（/var/ossec/logs/opnsense_syslog.log）是否也一樣處理，尚未驗證，在那些版本上開啟之前也請先測試。另請讓 OPNsense 保持在 26.1.8 以上：CVE-2026-34578（26.1.6）、CVE-2026-44193（26.1.7）、CVE-2026-44194 與 CVE-2026-45158（26.1.8）。
setup.verify: On a lab firewall, a failed login whose user name contains a line break, sent from an address you own, should show 131539 on the manager, and the plugin's file should hold it as one line. Until that holds, leave the response off.
setup.verify_zh: 在測試用防火牆上，從自己的位址送出一次使用者名稱含換行的失敗登入，manager 應出現 131539，且外掛程式的檔案裡應是一行。在確認之前，請保持該回應關閉。

setup.title: Optional: list accounts that log in for backups or monitoring
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出用於備份或監控而定期登入的帳號
setup.body: Not needed for a quiet default: such logins are already recorded below the alert level after the first one. Listing an account (one OPNsense user name per line, then reload the ruleset) also silences that first alert and root-level alerts for it. Its failures still alert.
setup.body_zh: 預設已經安靜，不需要這一步：這類登入在第一次之後就只記錄、不告警。列入清單（每行一個 OPNsense 使用者名稱，然後重新載入規則集）會連第一次的告警也靜音。失敗仍會告警。

setup.title: Keep successful web interface logins in the log
setup.title_zh: 保留網頁介面登入成功的記錄
setup.body: If System > Settings > Administration > "Disable logging of web GUI successful logins" is ticked, OPNsense does not write the line with the client address, and rules 131501 and 131504 cannot fire. The account still appears at level 2 (131506).
setup.body_zh: 若勾選了 System > Settings > Administration 的「Disable logging of web GUI successful logins」，OPNsense 不會寫出帶有來源位址的那一行，規則 131501 與 131504 無法觸發。帳號仍會以 level 2 出現（131506）。

setup.title: Also send syslog to the manager for sshd, API keys and login protection
setup.title_zh: 另外把 syslog 送到 manager，取得 sshd、API 金鑰與登入保護
setup.body: The plugin cannot select these. To get them: System > Settings > Logging > Remote, add a destination pointing at the manager's syslog port (the manager needs a <remote> syslog section that allows the firewall's address), transport UDP, RFC 5424 unticked, facilities auth (sshd) and local4 (API key messages). OPNsense's login protection (lockout_handler) logs under the user facility, which carries much more; add it only if that volume is acceptable. The events then arrive at the manager itself with the firewall's address as location, so the built-in sshd rules, 131517-131519 and 131555 apply; an active response for them must name the firewall's agent (defined-agent).
setup.body_zh: 外掛程式無法選取這些。要取得時：System > Settings > Logging > Remote 新增一個目的地，指向 manager 的 syslog 連接埠（manager 需要有允許該防火牆位址的 <remote> syslog 區段），傳輸 UDP，不勾 RFC 5424，facility 選 auth（sshd）與 local4（API 金鑰訊息）。OPNsense 的登入保護（lockout_handler）寫在 user facility，那裡的量大得多；能接受時再加上。事件會送到 manager 本身、以防火牆位址為 location，因此內建 sshd 規則、131517-131519 與 131555 會套用；針對它們的主動回應必須指定防火牆的 agent（defined-agent）。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the web interface, on the firewall itself
active_response.title_zh: 在防火牆本身封鎖一再登入網頁介面失敗的位址
active_response.body: Runs the os-wazuh-agent plugin's opnsense-fw script on the firewall that was attacked: the address is added to the alias __wazuh_agent_drop, which a block rule on every interface uses, and its open connections are killed, for 10 minutes. Needs Active response enabled in the plugin (on by default) and the opnsense-fw command defined on the manager (name opnsense-fw, executable opnsense-fw, timeout allowed). It only stops traffic that passes through the firewall: hosts on the attacker's own network segment are not protected. Risk: the address loses everything the firewall routes for it, not only the web interface. An administrator who mistypes six times locks out their workstation, and every user behind the same NAT address with them. Add administrator, monitoring and backup addresses to the manager's <global><white_list> first (the manager never sends a block for those), and exclude whole management networks with the plugin's Firewall command ignore alias. Keep it off on firewalls older than OPNsense 26.7.4 (26.4.2p1 for the Business Edition): before that fix a line break in the posted user name writes a failed-login line with any address the attacker picks (GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q), so six forged lines block whatever address they name. See the setup step about it.
active_response.body_zh: 在被攻擊的防火牆上執行 os-wazuh-agent 外掛程式的 opnsense-fw 腳本：把位址加入 __wazuh_agent_drop 別名（所有介面上都有一條封鎖規則使用它），並中斷它現有的連線，為期 10 分鐘。需要外掛程式啟用 Active response（預設開啟），並在 manager 定義 opnsense-fw 指令（名稱 opnsense-fw、執行檔 opnsense-fw、允許逾時）。它只擋得住經過防火牆的流量：與攻擊者在同一網段的主機不受保護。風險：該位址會失去防火牆替它轉送的一切，不只是網頁介面。打錯密碼六次的管理者會讓自己的工作站斷線，同一 NAT 位址後的所有使用者也一樣。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址加入 manager 的 <global><white_list>（manager 不會對這些位址送出封鎖），並以外掛程式的 Firewall command ignore 別名排除整個管理網段。OPNsense 26.7.4（Business Edition 為 26.4.2p1）之前的防火牆請保持關閉：修正之前，送出的使用者名稱含換行就能寫出一行位址任選的登入失敗記錄（GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q），六行偽造記錄就會封鎖其中寫的任何位址。請見相關的部署步驟。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to OpenVPN
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 OpenVPN 失敗的位址
active_response.body: Same mechanism as above, after six wrong user names or passwords from one address in five minutes. The address is usually on the internet, so blocking it at the edge is where it belongs. Risk: a mobile carrier's NAT address shared by many subscribers, or a hotel network, is blocked for every user behind it for 10 minutes, including your own staff there. Add administrator, monitoring and backup addresses to the manager's <global><white_list> first (the manager never sends a block for those), and exclude whole management networks with the plugin's Firewall command ignore alias.
active_response.body_zh: 機制同上，在同一位址五分鐘內六次帳號或密碼錯誤後觸發。這類位址通常在網際網路上，在邊界封鎖正是適當的位置。風險：行動業者由許多使用者共用的 NAT 位址或飯店網路，會讓其後的所有使用者被封鎖 10 分鐘，包括身在那裡的自家員工。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址加入 manager 的 <global><white_list>（manager 不會對這些位址送出封鎖），並以外掛程式的 Firewall command ignore 別名排除整個管理網段。

active_response.title: Block scanners at the edge: repeated firewall blocks, web interface scans, IKE probing
active_response.title_zh: 在邊界封鎖掃描者：多次防火牆封鎖、網頁介面掃描、IKE 探測
active_response.body: Blocks the source of the built-in 87702 (18 blocked packets from one source in 45 seconds), a web interface scan (131514) or repeated IKE requests from a non-peer (131588) for an hour, on every port: a scanner that hits closed ports first is kept away from the open ones too. It only helps for traffic that crosses the firewall. Risk: a wrong match blocks a whole site. A partner, a monitoring service or a CDN address that keeps hitting a blocked port, or an internal inventory scanner (87702 counts LAN-side blocks as well), loses all access through the firewall for an hour. Add administrator, monitoring and backup addresses to the manager's <global><white_list> first (the manager never sends a block for those), and exclude whole management networks with the plugin's Firewall command ignore alias. Known internal scanners and partners belong in that list too. The source address of a blocked packet or of an IKE request can be spoofed: a SYN or UDP packet needs no reply, so an outsider can make this response block an address of their choosing, such as your upstream DNS resolver, a partner or a monitoring service. Put those in the white list too.
active_response.body_zh: 對內建 87702（同一來源 45 秒內 18 個被擋封包）、網頁介面掃描（131514）或非對端一再送出的 IKE 請求（131588）的來源，在所有連接埠封鎖一小時：先掃關閉連接埠的掃描者，也會被擋在開放的連接埠之外。只對經過防火牆的流量有效。風險：誤判會封鎖整個站點。一再碰到被擋連接埠的合作夥伴、監控服務或 CDN 位址，或內部的資產盤點掃描器（87702 也計算 LAN 端的封鎖），會在一小時內失去經過防火牆的所有存取。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址加入 manager 的 <global><white_list>（manager 不會對這些位址送出封鎖），並以外掛程式的 Firewall command ignore 別名排除整個管理網段。已知的內部掃描器與合作夥伴也應列入。被擋封包與 IKE 請求的來源位址可以偽造：SYN 或 UDP 封包不需要回應，外人因此能讓這個回應封鎖他指定的位址，例如上游 DNS 解析器、合作夥伴或監控服務。這些位址也要列入白名單。
